request.description:
### Access

Any authenticated, **verified** user — owner, manager, stock manager, or cashier.  
This is a read-only endpoint; all staff need to see the shop's name and type.

### Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Authorization | `Bearer {{accessToken}}` |

### Success Response — `200 OK`

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Success",
  "data": {
    "id": "ddf74f73-6ed9-4277-aa56-9ba724dfe363",
    "name": "Akosua Provisions",
    "type": "provision_store",
    "ownerName": "Akosua Mensah",
    "phoneNumber": "0244123456",
    "locationRegion": "Greater Accra",
    "locationDistrict": "Ablekuma North",
    "tier": "tier2",
    "recordingMode": "transaction",
    "onboardingComplete": true,
    "createdAt": "2026-03-14T09:12:00.000Z"
  }
}

 ```

### Error Responses

| Status | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing, invalid, or expired access token |
| `403 Forbidden` | Token belongs to a user whose email is not yet verified |
| `404 Not Found` | Business record does not exist (should not occur under normal use) |

### Notes

- Business identity only — email and password live under Account Management, not here.

### Access

**Owner only.** Managers, stock managers, and cashiers receive `403 Forbidden`.

### Headers

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Authorization | `Bearer {{accessToken}}` |
| Content-Type | `application/json` |

### Body

All fields optional — send only what changed. At least one field is required.

``` json
{
  "name": "Akosua Provisions & More",
  "type": "provision_store",
  "ownerName": "Akosua Mensah",
  "phoneNumber": "0244123456",
  "locationRegion": "Greater Accra",
  "locationDistrict": "Okaikwei North"
}

 ```

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | 2–120 characters |
| `type` | enum | One of `BusinessType` (e.g. `provision_store`, `supermarket`, `pharmacy`, …) |
| `ownerName` | string | 2–120 characters |
| `phoneNumber` | string | 9–20 characters |
| `locationRegion` | string | 2–80 characters |
| `locationDistrict` | string | 2–80 characters |

### Success Response — `200 OK`

``` json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Success",
  "data": {
    "id": "ddf74f73-6ed9-4277-aa56-9ba724dfe363",
    "name": "Akosua Provisions & More",
    "type": "provision_store",
    "ownerName": "Akosua Mensah",
    "phoneNumber": "0244123456",
    "locationRegion": "Greater Accra",
    "locationDistrict": "Okaikwei North",
    "tier": "tier2",
    "recordingMode": "transaction",
    "onboardingComplete": true,
    "createdAt": "2026-03-14T09:12:00.000Z"
  }
}

 ```

### Error Responses

| Status | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `400 Bad Request` | Empty body, or a field fails validation (e.g. invalid `type` enum value) |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Missing, invalid, or expired access token |
| `403 Forbidden` | User is verified but not the owner, or email not yet verified |

### Notes

- Does not accept `email` or `password` — those are account-level, not business-level, and are managed separately.
    
- Unknown fields sent in the body are silently ignored, not rejected.
